# EvoPilot Dashboard

EvoPilot Dashboard is the standalone browser console for EvoPilot project evolution loops.

Useful entry points for AI Agents:

- AGENTS.md
- docs/ai-agents/README.md
- docs/workflows/end-to-end-scenarios.md
- docs/workflows/example-project-walkthroughs.md
- docs/reference/api-usage.md
- docs/operations/self-hosting.md
- docs/operations/release-management.md
- docs/reference/open-source-maturity-report.md

Rules:

- EvoPilot API is the system of record.
- Dashboard is an HTTP client only.
- Do not bypass human approval, ProjectHarnessProfile review, phase plan approval, release policy, RBAC, tenant/workspace scope, or audit.
- Stop on `nextAction`, blockers, `NO-GO`, `BLOCKED`, `FAILED`, or repair actions.
